w10_P4_001059: A rail depot wants the combined force, in kilonewtons, needed to start 9 identical model wagons at once. Each model wagon has a mass of 138 000 g. The wagons' acceleration, in m/s², is obtained by doubling the area under the curve y = 1·x² + 3x from x = 0 to x = 3 and then subtracting 15. What is the combined force, in kN?
w10_P4_001060: A go-kart club is preparing a final figure, in kilojoules: the total energy of motion of 7 identical model karts, each expressed in kilojoules, plus 3 kJ for the starter's flag mechanism. Each model kart has a mass of 7 kg and its track is 400 m long. Each kart's speed, in m/s, is 5 more than the number of ways to choose 2 drivers from 9. What is the final figure, in kJ?
w10_P4_001063: A dock crew needs the total force, in kilonewtons, for 6 identical cargo sleds pulled at once, each sled's force being stated in kilonewtons. Each sled's force is what is needed to accelerate its 52 000 g mass, less 11 N supplied by a tide-assisted slope. The sleds' acceleration, in m/s², is found by multiplying the sum of 7 and 4 by 3 and then subtracting 24. What is the total force, in kN?
w10_P4_001067: A 45 000 g barrel rolls along a brewery floor at a speed, in m/s, equal to the smaller root of x² - 10x + 21 = 0. The barrel holds 60 L. As it rolls it loses 7 J of its energy of motion to a floor seam and 8 J to a drain grate, then gains 30 J from a push. Express the barrel's resulting energy of motion in kJ.
w10_P4_001074: A 33 kg workshop trolley moves at a speed, in m/s, equal to the greatest common divisor of 357 and 341. Its energy of motion at that speed is expressed in kilojoules. The trolley is 0.8 m wide. The workshop runs 6 identical trolleys together, adds 14 kJ from a battery pack to their combined figure, and then, for 6 shifts, multiplies the result by 6. What is the final energy figure, in kJ?
w10_P4_001075: A 95 kg robot chassis is accelerated at a rate, in m/s², equal to the area under the curve y = 2x² + 1·x from x = 0 to x = 1. The factory runs 9 identical chassis at once, and a shared cable harness adds 24 N of drag to their combined force requirement. The plant has 8 such lines, and it runs 2 shifts. What total force, in N, is required across all lines and shifts?
w10_P4_001076: A 51 kg spinning-rig test mass moves at a speed, in m/s, equal to the area under the curve y = 4x² + 3x from x = 3 to x = 4. A booster adds 20 J to its energy of motion. The rig runs 10 identical masses at once, the combined figure is expressed in kilojoules, and the campaign repeats over 10 days. What is the total energy of motion, in kJ, over the campaign?
w10_P4_001082: A quarry manager is rating a fleet of 8 identical dumpers: the fleet rating, in kilonewtons, is 8 times the net figure for one dumper. That net figure is the force for the dumper's 8 axle-modules moving together, expressed in kilonewtons, minus 30 kN recovered by the engine brake. Each axle-module has a mass of 55 000 g. The acceleration, in m/s², is 3 times the sum of 8 and 16. What is the fleet rating, in kN?
w10_P4_001083: A lab technician reports a total energy, in joules, for a puck experiment: 19 J stored in the launcher spring, plus the combined energy of 7 identical pucks. Each puck's energy is its energy of motion plus 16 J from a magnetic kick. Each puck has a mass of 3 kg. Its speed, in m/s, is the greatest common divisor of 77 and 12. What is the total energy, in J?
w10_P4_001085: A 7 000 g drone is pushed forward by its rotors with an acceleration, in m/s², equal to the larger root of x² - 7x + 12 = 0. The forward force from the rotors is expressed in kilonewtons. A 24 kN backward tether tension is then applied to the drone. The test uses 6 identical drones per rig and 12 rigs. What is the net forward force, in kN, across all the drones, with backward forces counted as negative?
w10_P4_001086: A 45 000 g crate slides along a loading dock at a speed, in m/s, equal to the greatest common divisor of 331 and 309. The dock is 25 m long. A push adds 28 J to the crate's energy of motion, and a rough patch removes 13 J. The result is expressed in kilojoules, and there are 6 identical crates. What is the combined energy of motion of the 6 crates, in kJ?
w10_P4_001091: A crane depot wants the total force, in kilonewtons, for 10 identical hoists lifting at once, each stated in kilonewtons. Each hoist accelerates a 115 kg load, with gravity balanced by a counterweight. The load's cable is 18 m long. The acceleration, in m/s², is 21 more than the rate at which the slope of the curve y = 4x³ + 4x² is itself changing at x = 1. What is the total force, in kN?
w10_P4_001093: A logistics analyst wants the total force, in newtons, across 5 regions, each with 3 hubs, each with 9 lines, each with 12 identical carts accelerating at once. Each cart has a mass of 21 kg and is 0.9 m long. The acceleration, in m/s², equals the rate at which the slope of the curve y = 4x³ + 4x² is itself changing at x = 2. What is the total force, in N?
w10_P4_001097: A workshop foreman reports the total force, in newtons, on a bench rig: 19 N from a final clamp, 1 N from a sensor spring, 6 N from a cable, and the force for 12 identical sliders accelerating at once. Each slider has a mass of 21 kg. The acceleration, in m/s², is the greatest common divisor of 222 and 215. What is the total force, in N?
w10_P4_001106: A physics teacher is compiling a final figure, in kilojoules: 13 kJ for the launcher's stored energy, plus the combined energy of motion of 12 identical carts, each expressed in kilojoules. Each cart has a mass of 6 000 g and the track is 4 m long. Each cart's speed, in m/s, equals the rate at which the slope of the curve y = 4x³ - 4x² is itself changing at x = 1. What is the final figure, in kJ?
w10_P4_001107: A 14 kg sled is accelerated forward at a rate, in m/s², equal to the larger root of x² - 7x + 10 = 0. The sled is 1.2 m long. The forward force is expressed in kilonewtons, and 5 identical sleds are linked. A 12 kN backward brake force is then applied to the linked group, followed by a 19 kN forward push from a booster. What is the net forward force, in kN, on the group?
w10_P4_001111: A hobby club wants the net energy balance, in kilojoules, of a launcher's battery after 7 shots: it is the total energy of motion delivered to 7 identical 56 000 g projectiles, expressed in kilojoules, minus 9 kJ drawn by the launcher's heater, plus 19 kJ from a recharge. The launcher tube is 0.5 m long. Each projectile's speed, in m/s, is the greatest common divisor of 125 and 209. What is the net energy balance, in kJ?
w10_P4_001116: A 151 000 g mining skip is accelerated along its rail at a rate, in m/s², equal to the number of ways to choose 3 shafts from 6. The rail is 300 m long. The force for one skip is stated in kilonewtons. The mine runs 3 skips per level and has 5 levels, all operating at once. What total force, in kN, is required?
w10_P4_001129: A courier firm is summing the energy of motion, in kilojoules, of 9 vans, each carrying 8 identical parcels, with each van's figure expressed in kilojoules. Each parcel has a mass of 7 000 g. Each parcel's speed, in m/s, is 6 more than the slope of the curve y = 4x³ - 3x² at x = 1. What is the summed energy of motion, in kJ?
w10_P4_001136: A 56 000 g motorbike-and-rider test mass moves at a speed, in m/s, equal to 3 times the sum of 2 and 15. The test track is 800 m long. The lab runs 2 identical test masses at once, then adds 27 J from a tailwind, 23 J from a downhill section, and 3 J from a push. What is the combined energy of motion, in J?
w10_P4_001142: A safety consultant is totalling the energy of motion, in joules, of 5 groups of 9 identical crash sleds. Each sled's figure is its energy of motion, less 4 J lost to rail friction and 23 J lost to air drag. Each sled has a mass of 55 000 g. Its speed, in m/s, is 3 times the sum of 9 and 5. What is the total energy of motion, in J?
w10_P4_001143: A 31 000 g crate rolls at a speed, in m/s, equal to the greatest common divisor of 271 and 241. Its energy of motion at that speed is expressed in kilojoules. The warehouse moves 7 identical crates at once, and a lift adds 19 kJ to the combined figure. What is the final energy figure, in kJ?
w10_P4_001144: A haulage engineer is reporting the total force, in newtons, on a twin-cart train: 1 N for a coupling spring, plus 2 times the force for a single cart, where each cart's force includes 2 N of bearing drag on top of the force needed to accelerate its 189 kg mass. The carts are 2.5 m long. The acceleration, in m/s², equals the area under the curve y = 4x² + 5x from x = 3 to x = 4. What is the total force, in N?
w10_P4_001146: A club treasurer is reporting the net energy balance, in kilojoules, for 3 identical launch runs. Each run's balance is the projectile's energy of motion, expressed in kilojoules, minus 19 kJ drawn from the launcher's battery. The projectile has a mass of 10 kg. Its speed, in m/s, is found by multiplying the sum of 5 and 6 by 3 and then subtracting 23. What is the net energy balance, in kJ?
w10_P4_001147: A logistics firm wants the total force, in kilonewtons, across 11 regions, each with 8 depots, each with 12 identical carts accelerating at once, with each cart's force stated in kilonewtons. Each cart has a mass of 59 000 g and is 1.5 m long. The acceleration, in m/s², equals the area under the curve y = 5x² + 1·x from x = 1 to x = 3. What is the total force, in kN?
